people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

translations.web: Isaac said to them, “Why have you come to me, since you hate me, and have sent me away from you?”
translations.bsb: “Why have you come to me?” Isaac asked them. “You hated me and sent me away.”
translations.kjv: And Isaac said unto them, Wherefore come ye to me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away
translations.asv: And Isaac said unto them, Wherefore are ye come unto me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?
